name: Common lodge
drawing_accuracy: diagrammatic; dimensions and openings require professional verification
summary: Two reclaimed 40-foot high-cube containers act as service cores either side of a 6 m timber-framed gathering hall with clerestory windows. Shared kitchen, pantry, laundry and a separated mechanical and battery room on the north; workshop and tool library, two washrooms (one universal) and a boot room on the south.

provenance.source: Original concept geometry. No third-party plans, models or drawings are used.
provenance.method: Parametric. All drawings, the OBJ model and the browser explorer are generated from this file by tools/build.mjs.
provenance.verification: None. Not reviewed by an architect, engineer, building official or accessibility consultant.

module.note: Typical published dimensions for a 40-foot high cube. Measure the actual units.

bays.name: Gathering hall
bays.structure: Timber frame (glulam or reclaimed heavy timber) spanning between the modules

envelope.unspecified: Air, vapour, thermal bridge and fastening details are intentionally unspecified. The roof steps between hall and modules need snow-drift, flashing and drainage design.

foundation.type: Helical (screw) piles under the modules and the hall floor cassette: concept placeholder
foundation.note: Pile layout, type, depth and bearing need geotechnical investigation and structural design.

rooms.name: Shared kitchen
rooms.use: Community kitchen with a 4.2 m wide servery opening to the hall.
rooms.accessibility: About 1.6 m clear in front of the counter. Include a lowered work section with knee space and front-mounted controls.

rooms.name: Pantry and cold storage
rooms.use: Shared bulk food storage reached from the kitchen.
rooms.accessibility: Reachable shelving between 0.4 m and 1.2 m for frequently used items.

rooms.name: Laundry
rooms.use: Shared washer and dryer, reached from the hall.
rooms.accessibility: Front-loading machines on a raised plinth; 1.5 m clear in front.

rooms.name: Mechanical and battery room
rooms.use: Heat pump, water storage, PV inverter and battery storage. Exterior door only; no door to the occupied building.
rooms.accessibility: Service space; not a public room.
rooms.safety: Battery storage needs fire separation, ventilation, clearances and protection as required by the manufacturer, the electrical code and the fire code.

rooms.name: Gathering hall
rooms.use: Shared meals, meetings, workshops and events. Clerestory windows on both sides; glazed doors to the screened porch on the west and the main entry on the east.
rooms.accessibility: Step-free from both ramps. Plan seating with wheelchair spaces dispersed, a hearing loop for meetings and good daylight without glare.

rooms.name: Workshop and tool library
rooms.use: Shared tools, repair bench and bicycle maintenance. Supports the repair-first approach to the buildings.
rooms.accessibility: Adjustable-height bench section; 1.2 m wide double door to the hall.

rooms.name: Washroom with shower
rooms.use: Toilet, sink and shower for guests and work days.
rooms.accessibility: Not designed as the accessible washroom; see the universal washroom.

rooms.name: Universal washroom
rooms.use: Single-user, all-gender accessible washroom with an adult-size change table.
rooms.accessibility: 2.35 x 2.27 m clear; 1.0 m door (consider a power operator). Turning space, transfer space, grab bars and the change table to be designed to CSA B651 and the applicable code.

rooms.name: Boot room
rooms.use: Winter entry with bench, boot drying and a separate exterior door to the east.
rooms.accessibility: Bench at 0.45 m with clear floor space beside it.

openings.name: Glazed sliding doors to screened porch

porches.name: Screened porch
porches.note: Bug-screened outdoor room for summer meals and meetings.

porches.name: Covered entry deck
porches.note: Canopy keeps snow and rain off the main entry and the top of the ramp.

ramps.note: Main accessible route from the shared parking. Concept only.
Second step-free exit toward the cabin paths. Concept only.

trellis.note: Free-standing trellis shading the workshop windows in summer.

pv.label: PV array on the hall and south module

biosolar.label: Biosolar: green roofs on both modules, PV on the hall and raised over the south module

roof.note: No PV on the north module: the taller hall shades it in winter. Snow drifts against the clerestory walls must be engineered.

design_targets.note: Project targets, not code values. Verify against CSA B651 and the applicable provincial building code.

design_intent: two reclaimed modules as service cores
separated mechanical and battery room with exterior access only
PV only where it is not shaded

material_passport.material: Weathering steel, corrugated walls and roof, steel cross-members
material_passport.condition_assessment: Required before purchase: corrosion, deformation, CSC plate history, prior cargo, coatings and floor treatment.
material_passport.connections: Large openings toward the hall need engineered steel framing and transfer beams.
material_passport.disassembly: Modules can be lifted out once the hall roof is removed.
material_passport.end_of_life: Reuse as modules, otherwise steel recycling.

material_passport.material: Glulam or reclaimed heavy timber, insulated timber roof and floor cassettes
material_passport.source: Local certified or graded reclaimed timber
material_passport.condition_assessment: Grade reclaimed members; check for preservatives and lead paint.
material_passport.disassembly: Cassettes and frames unbolt in reverse order

material_passport.material: Wood fibre or mineral wool (TBD); timber rainscreen
material_passport.condition_assessment: Verify type, contamination and fire classification of any reclaimed board.

material_passport.material: Battery chemistry TBD (prefer chemistries with lower thermal runaway risk)
material_passport.condition_assessment: Certified listing; installation per manufacturer and code.
material_passport.connections: Separate fire-rated room with exterior access

reviews_required.topic: Occupancy classification: a shared gathering hall may be treated as an assembly occupancy, with higher fire, egress and accessibility requirements
Structure: large openings in the modules, hall frame, snow drift at roof steps, lifting
Fire: separations, battery room, egress, firefighting access and water supply
reviews_required.reviewer: Fire protection engineer and fire department

reviews_required.topic: Accessibility: ramps, entrances, universal washroom, kitchen, assembly seating
reviews_required.reviewer: Accessibility consultant; CSA B651 and applicable code

reviews_required.topic: Water, wastewater and food handling for shared meals
reviews_required.reviewer: Public health unit and wastewater approvals authority
